summary: A Codex seat whose resume under the default profile fails now reports why; before it reported only a closed channel

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database, claim or configuration schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Only the text of a startup failure changes. A seat whose saved thread has not taken a turn still fails closed under declared permissions; the failure now says the saved thread has no persisted rollout.

manual.detail: None. A seat that fails with a missing rollout takes one turn on its previous declaration, which saves the thread, and then restarts on the new one.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the less specific failure text.
